skills.name: Overturned Country
skills.text: Zhen Ji can use any black hand card as escape.

skills.name: River Goddess
skills.text: Before her judgment phase, Zhen Ji can choose to flip a judgment card. If the card is black, she can continue flipping additional cards. This process repeats until a red card is flipped. The red card is discarded, while all black cards are added to her hand.

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)
